name: customer_frustration

question.instructions: How frustrated is the customer who wrote this support message?
criteria: calm: neutral or positive; asks or reports without negative emotion
mildly annoyed: some irritation or impatience, still polite and measured
frustrated: clearly upset (repeated problems, complaints, demands) but not hostile
furious: enraged or hostile (shouting, insults, threats to cancel, sue or go public)

notes: graded_tone: an ordinal tone judgment over the whole message. Predicted: both understudents learn the extremes; adjacent levels are hard, so graduation needs the confident subset; understudent's pooled features may help modestly. Partial takeover is the likely outcome.
